column3: if - The Abominable Kirino Chapter
Ahhh, that was awesome!
Haven't you had enough? Any more and my stomach's going to tie itself up in knots...
Huh?! What do you mean?
There's still more?!
This is the last one! Besides, now that we've come to Akiba, we can't just go home, right?
Just where do you want to go?
It's alright; just follow me!
Alright, alright... Now that it's come to this, I might as well go all the way.
The place I was dragged to, dead tired, was an deep PC game store.
The moment I stepped in, my vision was filled with the figure of a male clerk wearing cat ears for some reason.
What... is this shop?!
It's a game store.
I can see that.
You're the one who asked what it was.
I mean, why am I here?
Right! The games that are written here; go buy all of them.
...Huh?
Kirino held out a note while wearing a big grin. On it was a lineup of titles of pornographic suggestiveness.
You... this is...
They're consumer games.
Really?!
Yeah. They're highly talked about games, but there weren't published in great numbers.
Oh...
Oh, it's alright! They're not like that.
But, there's gotta be a few that are close?
...Well, a few?
I knew it...
So go buy them.
Well, I mean, why...
I've checked on the net already, but sometimes some new unsold used items comes out.
So that's what I have to buy. But if you're the one who wants them, why are you making me? You can just buy them yourself.
Huh?! What do you mean? All of that is for you.
Huh?!
That's why you're such a fickle otaku. Did you really think I would play those kind of games?
That's why it's for your sake. Doesn't it seem like the best way to savor the game is to buy it yourself? C'mon, go buy them all.
A-Aren't you just making me go buy what you wanted in the first place?!
That is that. This is this.
That line is so like him, it's scary!  In any case, it's not like I can do this...
